source.name: City AM: Nike becomes London City Lionesses sponsor as well as kit partner in world record deal
source.note: Reported only as 'over £3m'; City AM does not state whether annual or total. Recorded per year, as owner Michele Kang told the BBC it beats 'some of the men's Premier League front-of-shirt deals' (annual figures). Multi-year deal announced by the club on 3 Sep 2026.
source.quote: club's front-of-shirt sponsor as well as kit maker for a world record fee of over £3m

note: Nike's first front-of-shirt sponsorship of a women's team in the UK per coverage.
